title: Art in Virtual Motion
summary: Embark on an extraordinary journey where art meets technology and challenges become opportunities for creativity. In this immersive workshop, participants dive into a unique experience that blends virtual reality technology with open-ended artistic exploration. Designed to break away from traditional boundaries, the workshop ignites creativity and encourages bold experimentation. Participants enter a virtual artistic space that invites them to explore, collaborate and take on creative challenges—leading to the creation of innovative artworks that go beyond the familiar and open new horizons of imagination.
